column.text: Page 1
Paragraph 1. The flow of the page is laid out as it always is, between the layer that paints under it and the layers that paint over it. Each layer is drawn after the flow has found its pages.
Paragraph 1. A layer holds shapes, text, images and barcodes at exact places on the page, and a layer with an opacity is drawn as one group and faded as a whole.

layer.text-at: Note 1. A text in a layer wraps at its width and keeps at most the lines it is given, and the last line ends in dots when the text does not fit. This one is longer than three lines on purpose, so that the engine has to cut it short and end it in dots, as it does with the long names and descriptions that a printed form has to fit in a box of a fixed size.
Note 1, wrapped and not cut. Four lines are enough for this text, which has no dots at its end.
